prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop portfolio project-page north-star comp, 1536x1024 landscape
Primary request: Design a new portfolio page titled "Savyy in the Hands." inside the established Activity Ledger identity. This is an experience-led case-study surface, not a product landing-page hero and not a copy of the existing homepage. The first viewport must let the real Savyy product lead: one wide desktop web-dashboard specimen and one tall official Savyy mobile screen share a large central canvas at clearly unequal scale, with the web specimen dominant and the phone crossing its edge. Connect those two product specimens with one precise numbered journey path that reads "01 CONNECT A BANK", "02 UNDERSTAND SPENDING", "03 ACT ON A BUDGET". Under or beside each step, use thin founder annotations to expose the systems built underneath: "Bridge / read-only consent", "shared web-mobile data", "private AI categorization", and "native biometrics / widgets / push". Place a narrow vertical founder index reading "BUILT SOLO" and "PRODUCT TO PRODUCTION". The main CTA is "OPEN SAVYY.APP"; secondary compact actions are "APP STORE" and "GOOGLE PLAY". At the bottom edge of the canvas, deliberately show the start of a deeper ruled section labeled "TECHNICAL EVIDENCE" continuing below the fold.
Input images: Image 1 is the portfolio identity reference only: carry over its midnight ruled-paper stock, cobalt structural rules, slab-serif/monospace type relationship, square dossier geometry, sparse data-lime marks, and singular signal-red proof gesture; do not copy its homepage layout, headline, content, chart, activity ledger, paperclips, or hero split. Images 2, 3, and 4 are official Savyy iOS product references only: use their authentic dark near-black interface, indigo/lilac accent, French personal-finance UI character, chart and transaction visual language, dense bottom navigation, and device appearance; do not import their blue marketing backdrop or promotional headline composition.
Scene/backdrop: a full desktop browser viewport made from tactile midnight-blue analyst paper with faint horizontal ledger ruling and restrained paper grain, enclosed by a crisp cobalt skeleton. A thin working-index header may identify "MARC MANSOUR" and "PROJECTS / SAVYY", but the page body must immediately become the product journey rather than a conventional navigation-plus-hero stack.
Subject: a portfolio case-study page showing Savyy in use across web and mobile. The wide web specimen should look like the same real Savyy product translated to desktop: a dark workspace with a bank/account rail, spending timeline, categories, a budget allocation field, and restrained charts. Use plausible interface demonstration data only, visually secondary and never presented as commercial proof. The tall mobile specimen must faithfully inherit the official Savyy screenshots' actual product appearance.
Style/medium: shippable, realistic desktop web UI comp with exceptional editorial art direction; Activity Ledger working-paper identity; Bitter-like sturdy slab-serif statements; Source Code Pro-like compact uppercase labels; square almost-flat dossier panels, 1px cobalt rules, tactile grain, physical overlap only where the mobile specimen crosses the web specimen.
Composition/framing: 1536x1024 landscape, straight-on browser screenshot, no browser chrome. Use an asymmetric editorial composition. A compact left title rail holds the large stacked slab-serif title "Savyy in the Hands." and the primary CTA. The central and right two-thirds are a single continuous product demonstration canvas, not cards: a large wide web dashboard specimen occupies most of it while one tall mobile specimen overlaps at a different scale. The numbered path runs continuously through the canvas and connects real moments inside the two interfaces. Founder annotations stay hairline-small but legible. The founder index is a very narrow ruled strip at the far right. Let the next technical-evidence section visibly begin within the bottom 12-18% of the frame.
Color palette: midnight paper #0b111b, raised night stock #111c2a, mineral ink #edf3f0, blueprint cobalt #78a8ff, sparse data lime #b9e84b, and exactly one signal-red #ff7d86 proof mark. Preserve Savyy's own near-black UI with indigo/lilac and teal only inside the product specimens.
Materials/textures: cool midnight paper grain, faint 32px ledger ruling, crisp cobalt hairlines, slightly lifted product specimens, no glossy glass.
Text (verbatim): "Savyy in the Hands."; "01 CONNECT A BANK"; "02 UNDERSTAND SPENDING"; "03 ACT ON A BUDGET"; "Bridge / read-only consent"; "shared web-mobile data"; "private AI categorization"; "native biometrics / widgets / push"; "BUILT SOLO"; "PRODUCT TO PRODUCTION"; "OPEN SAVYY.APP"; "APP STORE"; "GOOGLE PLAY"; "TECHNICAL EVIDENCE".
Constraints: high-fidelity real website screen; all specified text rendered exactly and legibly; the product is visibly Savyy; first viewport is experience-led; the journey sequence itself is informative; founder annotations explain implementation without dominating; only one tall mobile device; one dominant wide web specimen; show the start of deeper evidence below the fold; no invented commercial metrics, users, reviews, awards, rankings, conversion claims, or outcomes; no watermark.
Avoid: copying the homepage composition or content; generic SaaS hero; centered hero; product landing-page advertising; bento grid; card-grid feature lists; equal-sized feature cards; generic dashboard made of rounded stat tiles; giant metric; floating glass cards; gradients; glow; soft pill UI outside the embedded Savyy product; broad lime fills; multiple red accents; decorative paperclips; stock illustrations; hands or people; extra devices; fake logos; fabricated proof.
